```{r}
# Phase 1
# Find all sheet names
catch_sheets <- excel_sheets("estuary_catch_log.xlsx")

# Read each sheet and combine into one dataframe
catch_log <- catch_sheets |>
  set_names() |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ read_excel("estuary_catch_log.xlsx", sheet = .x),
    .id = "sheet"
  ) |>
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
# 2. STANDARDISE SITE AND SPECIES NAMES 

catch_log <- catch_log |>
  mutate(
    site = site |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_replace_all("\\s+", "_"),
    
    species = species |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
  )
```

```{r}
# 3. READ THE OTHER THREE DATASETS 

metadata <- read_csv("estuary_metadata.csv") |>
  clean_names()

sonde <- read_csv("estuary_sonde_data.csv") |>
  clean_names()

species_dictionary <- read_csv("species_dictionary.csv") |>
  clean_names()
```
```{r}
# 4. STANDARDISE MATCHING COLUMNS 

metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(
    site = site |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
  )

species_dictionary <- species_dictionary |>
  mutate(
    common_name = common_name |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_to_lower() |>
      str_replace_all("\\s+", "_")
  )

```

```{r}
# Create daily water quality summary
daily_water <- sonde |>
  mutate(
    date = floor_date(timestamp, unit = "day")
  ) |>
  group_by(site, date) |>
  summarise(
    mean_temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(daily_water)
```

```{r}
catch_translated <- catch_log |>
  left_join(
    species_dictionary,
    by = join_by(species == common_name)
  )
```

```{r}
catch_translated <- catch_translated |>
  select(-species) |>
  rename(species = scientific_name)

print(catch_translated)
```

```{r}
class(catch_translated$date)
class(daily_water$date)
```

```{r}
catch_translated <- catch_translated |>
  mutate(
    date = parse_date_time(
      date,
      orders = c("ymd", "dmy", "mdy")
    ) |>
      as.Date()
  )
```

```{r}
daily_water <- daily_water |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
```

```{r}
master_data <- catch_translated |>
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = join_by(site == site_name)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    daily_water,
    by = join_by(site, date)
  )

print(master_data)
```

```{r}
glimpse(master_data)
```

```{r}
summary(master_data)
```

```{r}

# PHASE 3: ZERO-CATCH FRAMEWORK


master_complete <- master_data |>
  complete(
    site,
    date,
    species
  ) |>
  mutate(
    count = coalesce(count, 0)
  )

print(master_complete)
```

```{r}
master_complete <- master_data |>
  complete(
    site,
    date,
    species,
    fill = list(count = NA)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    count = coalesce(count, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
catch_complete <- catch_translated |>
  complete(
    site,
    date,
    species
  ) |>
  mutate(
    count = coalesce(count, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
master_complete <- catch_complete |>
  left_join(
    metadata,
    by = join_by(site == site_name)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    daily_water,
    by = join_by(site, date)
  )
```

```{r}
# PHASE 4: STATISTICAL EXTRACTION

summary_table <- master_complete |>
  group_by(species, zone) |>
  summarise(
    mean_catch = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_catch = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(count))),
    
    mean_salinity = mean(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_salinity = sd(mean_salinity, na.rm = TRUE) / 
                  sqrt(sum(!is.na(mean_salinity))),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_table)
```

```{r}
summary_table_clean <- summary_table |>
  mutate(
    catch_mean_se = paste0(
      round(mean_catch, 2), " ± ", round(se_catch, 2)
    ),
    
    salinity_mean_se = paste0(
      round(mean_salinity, 2), " ± ", round(se_salinity, 2)
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    species,
    zone,
    catch_mean_se,
    salinity_mean_se
  )

print(summary_table_clean)
```

```{r}
# PHASE 5: VISUAL COMMUNICATION
ggplot(
  master_complete,
  aes(x = mean_salinity, y = count)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ species
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean daily salinity (PSU)",
    y = "Fish abundance (count)",
    title = "Fish abundance along the estuarine salinity gradient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
master_complete <- master_complete |>
  mutate(
    species_label = paste0(
      "italic('", species, "')"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  master_complete,
  aes(x = mean_salinity, y = count)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ species_label,
    labeller = label_parsed
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean daily salinity (PSU)",
    y = "Fish abundance (count)",
    title = "Fish abundance along the estuarine salinity gradient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
master_complete <- master_complete |>
  mutate(
    zone = factor(
      zone,
      levels = c("upstream", "mid_estuary", "downstream")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
levels(master_complete$zone)
```

```{r}
final_plot <- ggplot(
  master_complete,
  aes(x = mean_salinity, y = count)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = zone),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ species_label,
    labeller = label_parsed,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fish abundance along the estuarine salinity gradient",
    x = "Mean daily salinity (PSU)",
    y = "Fish abundance (count)",
    shape = "Estuary zone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

final_plot
```
